Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to verify the refunds table matches the refunds W2 reported (orders 260 and 263). Starting by listing refunds.
The refunds table matches what W2 reported: orders 260 (8294) and 263 (8982). Next I need the customer list, so I'll call list_orders.
The refunds table matches W2's report, so I can proceed. The orders cover three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance came back as 29089. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Acme (29089) and birch (62075) both match the order totals minus refunds, so the balances look right. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance.
All three balances match the order totals minus the verified refunds: acme 46365 - 17276 = 29089, birch 62075, cobalt 50341. Refunds match W2's report, so I'll record the first payout, for acme.
Acme's payout of 29089 is recorded. Birch's balance of 62075 matches its orders (32750 + 29325) with no refunds, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme and birch are paid. Cobalt's balance of 50341 matches its orders (33488 + 16853) with no refunds, so I'll record its payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts were recorded successfully. The amounts match the order totals minus the verified refunds, so the batch is complete.
